comments.why: Tim Hunkin's remastered series on how machines work
comments.text: Tim Hunkin (the man behind these arcades) also did an excellent video series called "The secret life of machines" for the BBC in the 80s. It was recently remastered, and is now up on youtube: [VIDEO] (All three seasons!) I cannot recommend it strongly enough.

comments.text: It's (reasonably) easy to make your own electric motor, if you want a better understanding of how they work. Rex Garrod (of Battlebots fame) demonstrates his own one on Tim Hunkin's "The Secret Life of", here: [VIDEO]
